name: Sangüesa / Zangoza (Spain)
description: Red field with a white rectangle at the centre charged with the crowned arms of Sangüesa (a castle and bars within an oval, with the motto LA QUE NUNCA FALTÓ).
history: Municipal flag of Sangüesa/Zangoza; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Sangüesa arms — castle and bars within an oval, with the motto LA QUE NUNCA FALTÓ
